scripts.test:sanity: npm run pretest:nda && npm run -s prepare-results && node scripts/run-nda-with-report.js
scripts.test:nda:raw: node node_modules/@cucumber/cucumber/bin/cucumber.js -c config/cucumber.json --import ts-node/register --require features/support/hooks.ts --require features/step-definitions/nda/nda-all.steps.ts --format json:test-results/cucumber-report.json features/nda/nda-all.feature
scripts.test:nbil: npm run -s prepare-results && node node_modules/@cucumber/cucumber/bin/cucumber.js -c config/cucumber.json --import ts-node/register --require features/support/hooks.ts --require features/step-definitions/nbil/nbil-all.steps.ts --format json:test-results/cucumber-report.json features/nbil/nbil-all.feature && npm run -s generate-report
scripts.test:nbil:regression: npm run -s prepare-results && node node_modules/@cucumber/cucumber/bin/cucumber.js -c config/cucumber.json --import ts-node/register --require features/support/hooks.ts --require features/step-definitions/nbil/nbil-all.steps.ts --format json:test-results/cucumber-report.json features/nbilRegressionSuite/nbil-regression.feature && npm run -s generate-report
scripts.test:opportunity: npm run -s prepare-results && npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require features/support/hooks.ts --require features/step-definitions/CommonStepDefinitions/commonsteps.ts --format json:test-results/cucumber-report.json features/opportunityCreation/Opportunity.feature && npm run -s generate-report
